# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- gh-1577: an empty assistant completion after partial content (assistant
  text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is a
  bounded-retry provider hiccup — up to `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3)
  re-streams with exponential backoff (`emptyHiccupBaseDelay`,
  `emptyHiccupMaxBackoff`, both threaded through the `Agent` facade,
  `AgentWiringSpec`, and the CLI config), and exhaustion ends the run with
  a loud `StopReason.error` (headless exit 1, interactive error + prompt)
  instead of the silent exit-0 settle that killed the gh-1577 trials.
  Clean empties keep the #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics. The abort always
  wins: a cancel racing the final retry settles `StopReason.aborted` for
  any empty shape (the exit-contract race is pinned by tests), and the
  backoff sleep is cancellation-aware.

- gh-1556: bench pipeline stops bleeding score + fa deadline awareness.
  Bench: the harbor ladder kill uses the `[f]a` bracket trick and is
  wrapped so a kill failure can never replace the `TimeoutError` (the
  pre-fix self-matching `pkill` classified TB 2.0 ladder kills as agent
  crashes — a SOLVED task scored 0); progress-watch (stall-gap 360s per
  the gh-1430 watchdog invariant, flat abs ceiling 3600s) is the
  bench-harbor.yml default on every shard, with the harbor adapter
  picking the gap-aware `ProgressWatch` for parity with the
  terminal-bench adapter; the aggregate counts completeness by
  `result.json` presence (errored trials report as their own breakdown
  line; exit 1 only on genuinely lost trials) and renders the full
  report — table, errored breakdown, ledger row — to

{"newText":"## Unreleased

- gh-1603: unattended runs can no longer end as a clean success on empty
  model responses. Loop: from the second empty-hiccup retry on, the request
  carries a continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was
  empty/truncated — continue the task"; exact-text constant
  `emptyContinuationNudge`, emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript
  stays truthful) — a cap-truncated reasoning model re-streamed verbatim
  repeats the empty outcome, the nudge breaks the symmetry; the classifier

  budget rises to `AgentCliConfig.headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2 — the
  session ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive
  keeps the #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics), and a run that still settles
  empty prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a
  distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0.

{"content":"### Root Cause

An unattended (headless) fa run could still end as a clean success (exit 0) on empty model responses. Two gaps: (1) a clean empty completion settled after the REPL's one-shot `continue` nudge, and the headless exit-code switch only mapped `error`/`aborted` to non-zero — an empty settle exited 0 with no final answer; (2) the gh-1577 hiccup retries re-streamed the identical request, so a reasoning-only response truncated by the output cap (`maxOutputTokens` → `StopReason.length`) repeated the empty outcome with no new signal.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`: new exact-text `emptyContinuationNudge` marker + `isContinuationNudgeMessage`; the classifier treats the loop's nudge message as transparent so it never resets the turn's partial-content window.
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop_empty_completion.dart`: from the second hiccup retry on, the request carries the continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was empty/truncated — continue the task"), emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript stays a truthful record.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2) — headless ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive keeps the pinned #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` (`runHeadless`): a run that still settles on an empty completion prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0. Error (1) and aborted (130) terminals keep their existing codes.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/empty_completion_test.dart` — UT-N1..N4: nudge transparency in the turn window (a nudged retry stays a hiccup; a real user message still ends it).
- `test/agent/agent_loop_test.dart` — first retry plain, retries 2–3 carry the nudge; thinking-only truncated first response (the HT6UsCc shape) reaches a tool call on the next turn.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_empty_continuation_test.dart` — headless: 2 nudges then recovery exits 0; 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties end with `__FA_INCOMPLETE` + exit 1; hiccup exhaustion keeps its distinct loud-error exit; healthy answers unaffected.
- Full suite: 1713 tests passed, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Out of scope, unchanged: a NON-empty final answer cut by the output cap still settles normally (gh-1577's recoverable-empty boundary kept deliberately).
- The marker goes to the diagnostics channel (stderr on headless) — the bench adapter tee's both channels into `fa.txt` next to `__FA_EXIT`.

# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- gh-1577: an empty assistant completion after partial content (assistant
  text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is a
  bounded-retry provider hiccup — up to `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3)
  re-streams with exponential backoff (`emptyHiccupBaseDelay`,
  `emptyHiccupMaxBackoff`, both threaded through the `Agent` facade,
  `AgentWiringSpec`, and the CLI config), and exhaustion ends the run with
  a loud `StopReason.error` (headless exit 1, interactive error + prompt)
  instead of the silent exit-0 settle that killed the gh-1577 trials.
  Clean empties keep the #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics. The abort always
  wins: a cancel racing the final retry settles `StopReason.aborted` for
  any empty shape (the exit-contract race is pinned by tests), and the
  backoff sleep is cancellation-aware.

- gh-1556: bench pipeline stops bleeding score + fa deadline awareness.
  Bench: the harbor ladder kill uses the `[f]a` bracket trick and is
  wrapped so a kill failure can never replace the `TimeoutError` (the
  pre-fix self-matching `pkill` classified TB 2.0 ladder kills as agent
  crashes — a SOLVED task scored 0); progress-watch (stall-gap 360s per
  the gh-1430 watchdog invariant, flat abs ceiling 3600s) is the
  bench-harbor.yml default on every shard, with the harbor adapter
  picking the gap-aware `ProgressWatch` for parity with the
  terminal-bench adapter; the aggregate counts completeness by
  `result.json` presence (errored trials report as their own breakdown
  line; exit 1 only on genuinely lost trials) and renders the full
  report — table, errored breakdown, ledger row — to

{"newText":"## Unreleased

- gh-1603: unattended runs can no longer end as a clean success on empty
  model responses. Loop: from the second empty-hiccup retry on, the request
  carries a continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was
  empty/truncated — continue the task"; exact-text constant
  `emptyContinuationNudge`, emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript
  stays truthful) — a cap-truncated reasoning model re-streamed verbatim
  repeats the empty outcome, the nudge breaks the symmetry; the classifier

  budget rises to `AgentCliConfig.headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2 — the
  session ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive
  keeps the #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics), and a run that still settles
  empty prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a
  distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0.

{"content":"### Root Cause

An unattended (headless) fa run could still end as a clean success (exit 0) on empty model responses. Two gaps: (1) a clean empty completion settled after the REPL's one-shot `continue` nudge, and the headless exit-code switch only mapped `error`/`aborted` to non-zero — an empty settle exited 0 with no final answer; (2) the gh-1577 hiccup retries re-streamed the identical request, so a reasoning-only response truncated by the output cap (`maxOutputTokens` → `StopReason.length`) repeated the empty outcome with no new signal.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`: new exact-text `emptyContinuationNudge` marker + `isContinuationNudgeMessage`; the classifier treats the loop's nudge message as transparent so it never resets the turn's partial-content window.
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop_empty_completion.dart`: from the second hiccup retry on, the request carries the continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was empty/truncated — continue the task"), emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript stays a truthful record.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2) — headless ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive keeps the pinned #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` (`runHeadless`): a run that still settles on an empty completion prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0. Error (1) and aborted (130) terminals keep their existing codes.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/empty_completion_test.dart` — UT-N1..N4: nudge transparency in the turn window (a nudged retry stays a hiccup; a real user message still ends it).
- `test/agent/agent_loop_test.dart` — first retry plain, retries 2–3 carry the nudge; thinking-only truncated first response (the HT6UsCc shape) reaches a tool call on the next turn.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_empty_continuation_test.dart` — headless: 2 nudges then recovery exits 0; 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties end with `__FA_INCOMPLETE` + exit 1; hiccup exhaustion keeps its distinct loud-error exit; healthy answers unaffected.
- Full suite: 1713 tests passed, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Out of scope, unchanged: a NON-empty final answer cut by the output cap still settles normally (gh-1577's recoverable-empty boundary kept deliberately).
- The marker goes to the diagnostics channel (stderr on headless) — the bench adapter tee's both channels into `fa.txt` next to `__FA_EXIT`.

# weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)

{"content":"### Root Cause

An unattended (headless) fa run could still end as a clean success (exit 0) on empty model responses. Two gaps: (1) a clean empty completion settled after the REPL's one-shot `continue` nudge, and the headless exit-code switch only mapped `error`/`aborted` to non-zero — an empty settle exited 0 with no final answer; (2) the gh-1577 hiccup retries re-streamed the identical request, so a reasoning-only response truncated by the output cap (`maxOutputTokens` → `StopReason.length`) repeated the empty outcome with no new signal.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`: new exact-text `emptyContinuationNudge` marker + `isContinuationNudgeMessage`; the classifier treats the loop's nudge message as transparent so it never resets the turn's partial-content window.
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop_empty_completion.dart`: from the second hiccup retry on, the request carries the continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was empty/truncated — continue the task"), emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript stays a truthful record.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2) — headless ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive keeps the pinned #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` (`runHeadless`): a run that still settles on an empty completion prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0. Error (1) and aborted (130) terminals keep their existing codes.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/empty_completion_test.dart` — UT-N1..N4: nudge transparency in the turn window (a nudged retry stays a hiccup; a real user message still ends it).
- `test/agent/agent_loop_test.dart` — first retry plain, retries 2–3 carry the nudge; thinking-only truncated first response (the HT6UsCc shape) reaches a tool call on the next turn.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_empty_continuation_test.dart` — headless: 2 nudges then recovery exits 0; 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties end with `__FA_INCOMPLETE` + exit 1; hiccup exhaustion keeps its distinct loud-error exit; healthy answers unaffected.
- Full suite: 1713 tests passed, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Out of scope, unchanged: a NON-empty final answer cut by the output cap still settles normally (gh-1577's recoverable-empty boundary kept deliberately).
- The marker goes to the diagnostics channel (stderr on headless) — the bench adapter tee's both channels into `fa.txt` next to `__FA_EXIT`.

# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- gh-1577: an empty assistant completion after partial content (assistant
  text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is a
  bounded-retry provider hiccup — up to `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3)
  re-streams with exponential backoff (`emptyHiccupBaseDelay`,
  `emptyHiccupMaxBackoff`, both threaded through the `Agent` facade,
  `AgentWiringSpec`, and the CLI config), and exhaustion ends the run with
  a loud `StopReason.error` (headless exit 1, interactive error + prompt)
  instead of the silent exit-0 settle that killed the gh-1577 trials.
  Clean empties keep the #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics. The abort always
  wins: a cancel racing the final retry settles `StopReason.aborted` for
  any empty shape (the exit-contract race is pinned by tests), and the
  backoff sleep is cancellation-aware.

- gh-1556: bench pipeline stops bleeding score + fa deadline awareness.
  Bench: the harbor ladder kill uses the `[f]a` bracket trick and is
  wrapped so a kill failure can never replace the `TimeoutError` (the
  pre-fix self-matching `pkill` classified TB 2.0 ladder kills as agent
  crashes — a SOLVED task scored 0); progress-watch (stall-gap 360s per
  the gh-1430 watchdog invariant, flat abs ceiling 3600s) is the
  bench-harbor.yml default on every shard, with the harbor adapter
  picking the gap-aware `ProgressWatch` for parity with the
  terminal-bench adapter; the aggregate counts completeness by
  `result.json` presence (errored trials report as their own breakdown
  line; exit 1 only on genuinely lost trials) and renders the full
  report — table, errored breakdown, ledger row — to

{"newText":"## Unreleased

- gh-1603: unattended runs can no longer end as a clean success on empty
  model responses. Loop: from the second empty-hiccup retry on, the request
  carries a continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was
  empty/truncated — continue the task"; exact-text constant
  `emptyContinuationNudge`, emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript
  stays truthful) — a cap-truncated reasoning model re-streamed verbatim
  repeats the empty outcome, the nudge breaks the symmetry; the classifier
  treats that exact message as transparent, so the turn's partial-content
  window (gh-1577) survives a nudged retry. Headless: the empty-reply nudge
  budget rises to `AgentCliConfig.headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2 — the
  session ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive
  keeps the #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics), and a run that still settles
  empty prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a
  distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0.

{"content":"### Root Cause

An unattended (headless) fa run could still end as a clean success (exit 0) on empty model responses. Two gaps: (1) a clean empty completion settled after the REPL's one-shot `continue` nudge, and the headless exit-code switch only mapped `error`/`aborted` to non-zero — an empty settle exited 0 with no final answer; (2) the gh-1577 hiccup retries re-streamed the identical request, so a reasoning-only response truncated by the output cap (`maxOutputTokens` → `StopReason.length`) repeated the empty outcome with no new signal.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`: new exact-text `emptyContinuationNudge` marker + `isContinuationNudgeMessage`; the classifier treats the loop's nudge message as transparent so it never resets the turn's partial-content window.
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop_empty_completion.dart`: from the second hiccup retry on, the request carries the continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was empty/truncated — continue the task"), emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript stays a truthful record.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2) — headless ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive keeps the pinned #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` (`runHeadless`): a run that still settles on an empty completion prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0. Error (1) and aborted (130) terminals keep their existing codes.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/empty_completion_test.dart` — UT-N1..N4: nudge transparency in the turn window (a nudged retry stays a hiccup; a real user message still ends it).
- `test/agent/agent_loop_test.dart` — first retry plain, retries 2–3 carry the nudge; thinking-only truncated first response (the HT6UsCc shape) reaches a tool call on the next turn.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_empty_continuation_test.dart` — headless: 2 nudges then recovery exits 0; 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties end with `__FA_INCOMPLETE` + exit 1; hiccup exhaustion keeps its distinct loud-error exit; healthy answers unaffected.
- Full suite: 1713 tests passed, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Out of scope, unchanged: a NON-empty final answer cut by the output cap still settles normally (gh-1577's recoverable-empty boundary kept deliberately).
- The marker goes to the diagnostics channel (stderr on headless) — the bench adapter tee's both channels into `fa.txt` next to `__FA_EXIT`.

blocks.text:
# weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)

{"content":"### Root Cause

An unattended (headless) fa run could still end as a clean success (exit 0) on empty model responses. Two gaps: (1) a clean empty completion settled after the REPL's one-shot `continue` nudge, and the headless exit-code switch only mapped `error`/`aborted` to non-zero — an empty settle exited 0 with no final answer; (2) the gh-1577 hiccup retries re-streamed the identical request, so a reasoning-only response truncated by the output cap (`maxOutputTokens` → `StopReason.length`) repeated the empty outcome with no new signal.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`: new exact-text `emptyContinuationNudge` marker + `isContinuationNudgeMessage`; the classifier treats the loop's nudge message as transparent so it never resets the turn's partial-content window.
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop_empty_completion.dart`: from the second hiccup retry on, the request carries the continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was empty/truncated — continue the task"), emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript stays a truthful record.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2) — headless ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive keeps the pinned #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` (`runHeadless`): a run that still settles on an empty completion prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0. Error (1) and aborted (130) terminals keep their existing codes.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/empty_completion_test.dart` — UT-N1..N4: nudge transparency in the turn window (a nudged retry stays a hiccup; a real user message still ends it).
- `test/agent/agent_loop_test.dart` — first retry plain, retries 2–3 carry the nudge; thinking-only truncated first response (the HT6UsCc shape) reaches a tool call on the next turn.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_empty_continuation_test.dart` — headless: 2 nudges then recovery exits 0; 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties end with `__FA_INCOMPLETE` + exit 1; hiccup exhaustion keeps its distinct loud-error exit; healthy answers unaffected.
- Full suite: 1713 tests passed, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Out of scope, unchanged: a NON-empty final answer cut by the output cap still settles normally (gh-1577's recoverable-empty boundary kept deliberately).
- The marker goes to the diagnostics channel (stderr on headless) — the bench adapter tee's both channels into `fa.txt` next to `__FA_EXIT`.

blocks.text:
# weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips

      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)

{"content":"### Root Cause

An unattended (headless) fa run could still end as a clean success (exit 0) on empty model responses. Two gaps: (1) a clean empty completion settled after the REPL's one-shot `continue` nudge, and the headless exit-code switch only mapped `error`/`aborted` to non-zero — an empty settle exited 0 with no final answer; (2) the gh-1577 hiccup retries re-streamed the identical request, so a reasoning-only response truncated by the output cap (`maxOutputTokens` → `StopReason.length`) repeated the empty outcome with no new signal.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`: new exact-text `emptyContinuationNudge` marker + `isContinuationNudgeMessage`; the classifier treats the loop's nudge message as transparent so it never resets the turn's partial-content window.
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop_empty_completion.dart`: from the second hiccup retry on, the request carries the continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was empty/truncated — continue the task"), emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript stays a truthful record.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2) — headless ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive keeps the pinned #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` (`runHeadless`): a run that still settles on an empty completion prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0. Error (1) and aborted (130) terminals keep their existing codes.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/empty_completion_test.dart` — UT-N1..N4: nudge transparency in the turn window (a nudged retry stays a hiccup; a real user message still ends it).
- `test/agent/agent_loop_test.dart` — first retry plain, retries 2–3 carry the nudge; thinking-only truncated first response (the HT6UsCc shape) reaches a tool call on the next turn.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_empty_continuation_test.dart` — headless: 2 nudges then recovery exits 0; 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties end with `__FA_INCOMPLETE` + exit 1; hiccup exhaustion keeps its distinct loud-error exit; healthy answers unaffected.
- Full suite: 1713 tests passed, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Out of scope, unchanged: a NON-empty final answer cut by the output cap still settles normally (gh-1577's recoverable-empty boundary kept deliberately).
- The marker goes to the diagnostics channel (stderr on headless) — the bench adapter tee's both channels into `fa.txt` next to `__FA_EXIT`.

blocks.text:
# weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips

      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)

{"content":"### Root Cause

An unattended (headless) fa run could still end as a clean success (exit 0) on empty model responses. Two gaps: (1) a clean empty completion settled after the REPL's one-shot `continue` nudge, and the headless exit-code switch only mapped `error`/`aborted` to non-zero — an empty settle exited 0 with no final answer; (2) the gh-1577 hiccup retries re-streamed the identical request, so a reasoning-only response truncated by the output cap (`maxOutputTokens` → `StopReason.length`) repeated the empty outcome with no new signal.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`: new exact-text `emptyContinuationNudge` marker + `isContinuationNudgeMessage`; the classifier treats the loop's nudge message as transparent so it never resets the turn's partial-content window.
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop_empty_completion.dart`: from the second hiccup retry on, the request carries the continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was empty/truncated — continue the task"), emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript stays a truthful record.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2) — headless ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive keeps the pinned #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` (`runHeadless`): a run that still settles on an empty completion prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0. Error (1) and aborted (130) terminals keep their existing codes.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/empty_completion_test.dart` — UT-N1..N4: nudge transparency in the turn window (a nudged retry stays a hiccup; a real user message still ends it).
- `test/agent/agent_loop_test.dart` — first retry plain, retries 2–3 carry the nudge; thinking-only truncated first response (the HT6UsCc shape) reaches a tool call on the next turn.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_empty_continuation_test.dart` — headless: 2 nudges then recovery exits 0; 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties end with `__FA_INCOMPLETE` + exit 1; hiccup exhaustion keeps its distinct loud-error exit; healthy answers unaffected.
- Full suite: 1713 tests passed, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Out of scope, unchanged: a NON-empty final answer cut by the output cap still settles normally (gh-1577's recoverable-empty boundary kept deliberately).
- The marker goes to the diagnostics channel (stderr on headless) — the bench adapter tee's both channels into `fa.txt` next to `__FA_EXIT`.

# weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

An unattended (headless) fa run could still end as a clean success (exit 0) on empty model responses. Two gaps: (1) a clean empty completion settled after the REPL's one-shot `continue` nudge, and the headless exit-code switch only mapped `error`/`aborted` to non-zero — an empty settle exited 0 with no final answer; (2) the gh-1577 hiccup retries re-streamed the identical request, so a reasoning-only response truncated by the output cap (`maxOutputTokens` → `StopReason.length`) repeated the empty outcome with no new signal.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`: new exact-text `emptyContinuationNudge` marker + `isContinuationNudgeMessage`; the classifier treats the loop's nudge message as transparent so it never resets the turn's partial-content window.
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop_empty_completion.dart`: from the second hiccup retry on, the request carries the continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was empty/truncated — continue the task"), emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript stays a truthful record.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2) — headless ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive keeps the pinned #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` (`runHeadless`): a run that still settles on an empty completion prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0. Error (1) and aborted (130) terminals keep their existing codes.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/empty_completion_test.dart` — UT-N1..N4: nudge transparency in the turn window (a nudged retry stays a hiccup; a real user message still ends it).
- `test/agent/agent_loop_test.dart` — first retry plain, retries 2–3 carry the nudge; thinking-only truncated first response (the HT6UsCc shape) reaches a tool call on the next turn.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_empty_continuation_test.dart` — headless: 2 nudges then recovery exits 0; 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties end with `__FA_INCOMPLETE` + exit 1; hiccup exhaustion keeps its distinct loud-error exit; healthy answers unaffected.
- Full suite: 1713 tests passed, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Out of scope, unchanged: a NON-empty final answer cut by the output cap still settles normally (gh-1577's recoverable-empty boundary kept deliberately).
- The marker goes to the diagnostics channel (stderr on headless) — the bench adapter tee's both channels into `fa.txt` next to `__FA_EXIT`.

# weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)

{"content":"### Root Cause

An unattended (headless) fa run could still end as a clean success (exit 0) on empty model responses. Two gaps: (1) a clean empty completion settled after the REPL's one-shot `continue` nudge, and the headless exit-code switch only mapped `error`/`aborted` to non-zero — an empty settle exited 0 with no final answer; (2) the gh-1577 hiccup retries re-streamed the identical request, so a reasoning-only response truncated by the output cap (`maxOutputTokens` → `StopReason.length`) repeated the empty outcome with no new signal.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`: new exact-text `emptyContinuationNudge` marker + `isContinuationNudgeMessage`; the classifier treats the loop's nudge message as transparent so it never resets the turn's partial-content window.
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop_empty_completion.dart`: from the second hiccup retry on, the request carries the continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was empty/truncated — continue the task"), emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript stays a truthful record.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2) — headless ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive keeps the pinned #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` (`runHeadless`): a run that still settles on an empty completion prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0. Error (1) and aborted (130) terminals keep their existing codes.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/empty_completion_test.dart` — UT-N1..N4: nudge transparency in the turn window (a nudged retry stays a hiccup; a real user message still ends it).
- `test/agent/agent_loop_test.dart` — first retry plain, retries 2–3 carry the nudge; thinking-only truncated first response (the HT6UsCc shape) reaches a tool call on the next turn.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_empty_continuation_test.dart` — headless: 2 nudges then recovery exits 0; 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties end with `__FA_INCOMPLETE` + exit 1; hiccup exhaustion keeps its distinct loud-error exit; healthy answers unaffected.
- Full suite: 1713 tests passed, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Out of scope, unchanged: a NON-empty final answer cut by the output cap still settles normally (gh-1577's recoverable-empty boundary kept deliberately).
- The marker goes to the diagnostics channel (stderr on headless) — the bench adapter tee's both channels into `fa.txt` next to `__FA_EXIT`.

blocks.text:
# weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures

      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).

{"content":"### Root Cause

An unattended (headless) fa run could still end as a clean success (exit 0) on empty model responses. Two gaps: (1) a clean empty completion settled after the REPL's one-shot `continue` nudge, and the headless exit-code switch only mapped `error`/`aborted` to non-zero — an empty settle exited 0 with no final answer; (2) the gh-1577 hiccup retries re-streamed the identical request, so a reasoning-only response truncated by the output cap (`maxOutputTokens` → `StopReason.length`) repeated the empty outcome with no new signal.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`: new exact-text `emptyContinuationNudge` marker + `isContinuationNudgeMessage`; the classifier treats the loop's nudge message as transparent so it never resets the turn's partial-content window.
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop_empty_completion.dart`: from the second hiccup retry on, the request carries the continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was empty/truncated — continue the task"), emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript stays a truthful record.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2) — headless ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive keeps the pinned #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` (`runHeadless`): a run that still settles on an empty completion prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0. Error (1) and aborted (130) terminals keep their existing codes.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/empty_completion_test.dart` — UT-N1..N4: nudge transparency in the turn window (a nudged retry stays a hiccup; a real user message still ends it).
- `test/agent/agent_loop_test.dart` — first retry plain, retries 2–3 carry the nudge; thinking-only truncated first response (the HT6UsCc shape) reaches a tool call on the next turn.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_empty_continuation_test.dart` — headless: 2 nudges then recovery exits 0; 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties end with `__FA_INCOMPLETE` + exit 1; hiccup exhaustion keeps its distinct loud-error exit; healthy answers unaffected.
- Full suite: 1713 tests passed, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Out of scope, unchanged: a NON-empty final answer cut by the output cap still settles normally (gh-1577's recoverable-empty boundary kept deliberately).
- The marker goes to the diagnostics channel (stderr on headless) — the bench adapter tee's both channels into `fa.txt` next to `__FA_EXIT`.

      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips

      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \

{"content":"### Root Cause

An unattended (headless) fa run could still end as a clean success (exit 0) on empty model responses. Two gaps: (1) a clean empty completion settled after the REPL's one-shot `continue` nudge, and the headless exit-code switch only mapped `error`/`aborted` to non-zero — an empty settle exited 0 with no final answer; (2) the gh-1577 hiccup retries re-streamed the identical request, so a reasoning-only response truncated by the output cap (`maxOutputTokens` → `StopReason.length`) repeated the empty outcome with no new signal.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`: new exact-text `emptyContinuationNudge` marker + `isContinuationNudgeMessage`; the classifier treats the loop's nudge message as transparent so it never resets the turn's partial-content window.
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop_empty_completion.dart`: from the second hiccup retry on, the request carries the continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was empty/truncated — continue the task"), emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript stays a truthful record.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2) — headless ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive keeps the pinned #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` (`runHeadless`): a run that still settles on an empty completion prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0. Error (1) and aborted (130) terminals keep their existing codes.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/empty_completion_test.dart` — UT-N1..N4: nudge transparency in the turn window (a nudged retry stays a hiccup; a real user message still ends it).
- `test/agent/agent_loop_test.dart` — first retry plain, retries 2–3 carry the nudge; thinking-only truncated first response (the HT6UsCc shape) reaches a tool call on the next turn.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_empty_continuation_test.dart` — headless: 2 nudges then recovery exits 0; 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties end with `__FA_INCOMPLETE` + exit 1; hiccup exhaustion keeps its distinct loud-error exit; healthy answers unaffected.
- Full suite: 1713 tests passed, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Out of scope, unchanged: a NON-empty final answer cut by the output cap still settles normally (gh-1577's recoverable-empty boundary kept deliberately).
- The marker goes to the diagnostics channel (stderr on headless) — the bench adapter tee's both channels into `fa.txt` next to `__FA_EXIT`.

blocks.text:
# weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)

{"content":"### Root Cause

An unattended (headless) fa run could still end as a clean success (exit 0) on empty model responses. Two gaps: (1) a clean empty completion settled after the REPL's one-shot `continue` nudge, and the headless exit-code switch only mapped `error`/`aborted` to non-zero — an empty settle exited 0 with no final answer; (2) the gh-1577 hiccup retries re-streamed the identical request, so a reasoning-only response truncated by the output cap (`maxOutputTokens` → `StopReason.length`) repeated the empty outcome with no new signal.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`: new exact-text `emptyContinuationNudge` marker + `isContinuationNudgeMessage`; the classifier treats the loop's nudge message as transparent so it never resets the turn's partial-content window.
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop_empty_completion.dart`: from the second hiccup retry on, the request carries the continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was empty/truncated — continue the task"), emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript stays a truthful record.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2) — headless ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive keeps the pinned #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` (`runHeadless`): a run that still settles on an empty completion prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0. Error (1) and aborted (130) terminals keep their existing codes.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/empty_completion_test.dart` — UT-N1..N4: nudge transparency in the turn window (a nudged retry stays a hiccup; a real user message still ends it).
- `test/agent/agent_loop_test.dart` — first retry plain, retries 2–3 carry the nudge; thinking-only truncated first response (the HT6UsCc shape) reaches a tool call on the next turn.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_empty_continuation_test.dart` — headless: 2 nudges then recovery exits 0; 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties end with `__FA_INCOMPLETE` + exit 1; hiccup exhaustion keeps its distinct loud-error exit; healthy answers unaffected.
- Full suite: 1713 tests passed, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Out of scope, unchanged: a NON-empty final answer cut by the output cap still settles normally (gh-1577's recoverable-empty boundary kept deliberately).
- The marker goes to the diagnostics channel (stderr on headless) — the bench adapter tee's both channels into `fa.txt` next to `__FA_EXIT`.

blocks.text:
# weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)

{"content":"### Root Cause

An unattended (headless) fa run could still end as a clean success (exit 0) on empty model responses. Two gaps: (1) a clean empty completion settled after the REPL's one-shot `continue` nudge, and the headless exit-code switch only mapped `error`/`aborted` to non-zero — an empty settle exited 0 with no final answer; (2) the gh-1577 hiccup retries re-streamed the identical request, so a reasoning-only response truncated by the output cap (`maxOutputTokens` → `StopReason.length`) repeated the empty outcome with no new signal.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`: new exact-text `emptyContinuationNudge` marker + `isContinuationNudgeMessage`; the classifier treats the loop's nudge message as transparent so it never resets the turn's partial-content window.
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop_empty_completion.dart`: from the second hiccup retry on, the request carries the continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was empty/truncated — continue the task"), emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript stays a truthful record.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2) — headless ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive keeps the pinned #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` (`runHeadless`): a run that still settles on an empty completion prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0. Error (1) and aborted (130) terminals keep their existing codes.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/empty_completion_test.dart` — UT-N1..N4: nudge transparency in the turn window (a nudged retry stays a hiccup; a real user message still ends it).
- `test/agent/agent_loop_test.dart` — first retry plain, retries 2–3 carry the nudge; thinking-only truncated first response (the HT6UsCc shape) reaches a tool call on the next turn.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_empty_continuation_test.dart` — headless: 2 nudges then recovery exits 0; 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties end with `__FA_INCOMPLETE` + exit 1; hiccup exhaustion keeps its distinct loud-error exit; healthy answers unaffected.
- Full suite: 1713 tests passed, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Out of scope, unchanged: a NON-empty final answer cut by the output cap still settles normally (gh-1577's recoverable-empty boundary kept deliberately).
- The marker goes to the diagnostics channel (stderr on headless) — the bench adapter tee's both channels into `fa.txt` next to `__FA_EXIT`.

{"content":"### Root Cause

An unattended (headless) fa run could still end as a clean success (exit 0) on empty model responses. Two gaps: (1) a clean empty completion settled after the REPL's one-shot `continue` nudge, and the headless exit-code switch only mapped `error`/`aborted` to non-zero — an empty settle exited 0 with no final answer; (2) the gh-1577 hiccup retries re-streamed the identical request, so a reasoning-only response truncated by the output cap (`maxOutputTokens` → `StopReason.length`) repeated the empty outcome with no new signal.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`: new exact-text `emptyContinuationNudge` marker + `isContinuationNudgeMessage`; the classifier treats the loop's nudge message as transparent so it never resets the turn's partial-content window.

{"content":"### Root Cause

An unattended (headless) fa run could still end as a clean success (exit 0) on empty model responses. Two gaps: (1) a clean empty completion settled after the REPL's one-shot `continue` nudge, and the headless exit-code switch only mapped `error`/`aborted` to non-zero — an empty settle exited 0 with no final answer; (2) the gh-1577 hiccup retries re-streamed the identical request, so a reasoning-only response truncated by the output cap (`maxOutputTokens` → `StopReason.length`) repeated the empty outcome with no new signal.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`: new exact-text `emptyContinuationNudge` marker + `isContinuationNudgeMessage`; the classifier treats the loop's nudge message as transparent so it never resets the turn's partial-content window.
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop_empty_completion.dart`: from the second hiccup retry on, the request carries the continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was empty/truncated — continue the task"), emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript stays a truthful record.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2) — headless ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive keeps the pinned #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` (`runHeadless`): a run that still settles on an empty completion prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0. Error (1) and aborted (130) terminals keep their existing codes.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/empty_completion_test.dart` — UT-N1..N4: nudge transparency in the turn window (a nudged retry stays a hiccup; a real user message still ends it).
- `test/agent/agent_loop_test.dart` — first retry plain, retries 2–3 carry the nudge; thinking-only truncated first response (the HT6UsCc shape) reaches a tool call on the next turn.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_empty_continuation_test.dart` — headless: 2 nudges then recovery exits 0; 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties end with `__FA_INCOMPLETE` + exit 1; hiccup exhaustion keeps its distinct loud-error exit; healthy answers unaffected.
- Full suite: 1713 tests passed, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Out of scope, unchanged: a NON-empty final answer cut by the output cap still settles normally (gh-1577's recoverable-empty boundary kept deliberately).
- The marker goes to the diagnostics channel (stderr on headless) — the bench adapter tee's both channels into `fa.txt` next to `__FA_EXIT`.

# weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538

{"content":"### Root Cause

An unattended (headless) fa run could still end as a clean success (exit 0) on empty model responses. Two gaps: (1) a clean empty completion settled after the REPL's one-shot `continue` nudge, and the headless exit-code switch only mapped `error`/`aborted` to non-zero — an empty settle exited 0 with no final answer; (2) the gh-1577 hiccup retries re-streamed the identical request, so a reasoning-only response truncated by the output cap (`maxOutputTokens` → `StopReason.length`) repeated the empty outcome with no new signal.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`: new exact-text `emptyContinuationNudge` marker + `isContinuationNudgeMessage`; the classifier treats the loop's nudge message as transparent so it never resets the turn's partial-content window.
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop_empty_completion.dart`: from the second hiccup retry on, the request carries the continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was empty/truncated — continue the task"), emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript stays a truthful record.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2) — headless ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive keeps the pinned #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` (`runHeadless`): a run that still settles on an empty completion prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0. Error (1) and aborted (130) terminals keep their existing codes.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/empty_completion_test.dart` — UT-N1..N4: nudge transparency in the turn window (a nudged retry stays a hiccup; a real user message still ends it).
- `test/agent/agent_loop_test.dart` — first retry plain, retries 2–3 carry the nudge; thinking-only truncated first response (the HT6UsCc shape) reaches a tool call on the next turn.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_empty_continuation_test.dart` — headless: 2 nudges then recovery exits 0; 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties end with `__FA_INCOMPLETE` + exit 1; hiccup exhaustion keeps its distinct loud-error exit; healthy answers unaffected.
- Full suite: 1713 tests passed, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Out of scope, unchanged: a NON-empty final answer cut by the output cap still settles normally (gh-1577's recoverable-empty boundary kept deliberately).
- The marker goes to the diagnostics channel (stderr on headless) — the bench adapter tee's both channels into `fa.txt` next to `__FA_EXIT`.

# weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips

      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538

      # single unit-lcov producer now).

{"content":"### Root Cause

An unattended (headless) fa run could still end as a clean success (exit 0) on empty model responses. Two gaps: (1) a clean empty completion settled after the REPL's one-shot `continue` nudge, and the headless exit-code switch only mapped `error`/`aborted` to non-zero — an empty settle exited 0 with no final answer; (2) the gh-1577 hiccup retries re-streamed the identical request, so a reasoning-only response truncated by the output cap (`maxOutputTokens` → `StopReason.length`) repeated the empty outcome with no new signal.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`: new exact-text `emptyContinuationNudge` marker + `isContinuationNudgeMessage`; the classifier treats the loop's nudge message as transparent so it never resets the turn's partial-content window.
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop_empty_completion.dart`: from the second hiccup retry on, the request carries the continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was empty/truncated — continue the task"), emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript stays a truthful record.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2) — headless ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive keeps the pinned #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` (`runHeadless`): a run that still settles on an empty completion prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0. Error (1) and aborted (130) terminals keep their existing codes.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/empty_completion_test.dart` — UT-N1..N4: nudge transparency in the turn window (a nudged retry stays a hiccup; a real user message still ends it).
- `test/agent/agent_loop_test.dart` — first retry plain, retries 2–3 carry the nudge; thinking-only truncated first response (the HT6UsCc shape) reaches a tool call on the next turn.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_empty_continuation_test.dart` — headless: 2 nudges then recovery exits 0; 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties end with `__FA_INCOMPLETE` + exit 1; hiccup exhaustion keeps its distinct loud-error exit; healthy answers unaffected.
- Full suite: 1713 tests passed, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Out of scope, unchanged: a NON-empty final answer cut by the output cap still settles normally (gh-1577's recoverable-empty boundary kept deliberately).
- The marker goes to the diagnostics channel (stderr on headless) — the bench adapter tee's both channels into `fa.txt` next to `__FA_EXIT`.

      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})

          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets

{"content":"### Root Cause

An unattended (headless) fa run could still end as a clean success (exit 0) on empty model responses. Two gaps: (1) a clean empty completion settled after the REPL's one-shot `continue` nudge, and the headless exit-code switch only mapped `error`/`aborted` to non-zero — an empty settle exited 0 with no final answer; (2) the gh-1577 hiccup retries re-streamed the identical request, so a reasoning-only response truncated by the output cap (`maxOutputTokens` → `StopReason.length`) repeated the empty outcome with no new signal.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`: new exact-text `emptyContinuationNudge` marker + `isContinuationNudgeMessage`; the classifier treats the loop's nudge message as transparent so it never resets the turn's partial-content window.
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop_empty_completion.dart`: from the second hiccup retry on, the request carries the continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was empty/truncated — continue the task"), emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript stays a truthful record.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2) — headless ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive keeps the pinned #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` (`runHeadless`): a run that still settles on an empty completion prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0. Error (1) and aborted (130) terminals keep their existing codes.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/empty_completion_test.dart` — UT-N1..N4: nudge transparency in the turn window (a nudged retry stays a hiccup; a real user message still ends it).
- `test/agent/agent_loop_test.dart` — first retry plain, retries 2–3 carry the nudge; thinking-only truncated first response (the HT6UsCc shape) reaches a tool call on the next turn.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_empty_continuation_test.dart` — headless: 2 nudges then recovery exits 0; 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties end with `__FA_INCOMPLETE` + exit 1; hiccup exhaustion keeps its distinct loud-error exit; healthy answers unaffected.
- Full suite: 1713 tests passed, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Out of scope, unchanged: a NON-empty final answer cut by the output cap still settles normally (gh-1577's recoverable-empty boundary kept deliberately).
- The marker goes to the diagnostics channel (stderr on headless) — the bench adapter tee's both channels into `fa.txt` next to `__FA_EXIT`.

blocks.text:
# weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the

# weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

blocks.text:
# weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538

# weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

# weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).

      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
